abstract: The Toronto Section meeting, held on 9 June, was the second attempt by the Section to provide a virtual meeting environment due to the new social distancing mandates. Everytime we take on this new initiative, it becomes a little easier to execute. The platform does take on some new challenges, which indeed require a few dry runs.
